title: Groupware Workspace Access Missing After Department Transfer
content: Synthetic incident at Example Manufacturing. A user moved from Quality to Engineering and could sign in to groupware but could not open the Engineering project workspace. Investigation found that the workspace membership cache had not reflected the approved department transfer. IT Support verified the membership and role synchronization status without changing access. The user fully signed out, reopened the browser, and signed in again. The unresolved request was escalated to Enterprise Applications Support for authorized membership review. This historical incident does not confirm the cause of a new user's issue.
